description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Treva's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Treva's Attendant, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Treva's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
Repeat.
